title: Losing your way of life to climate change matters — and we need a way to measure it
title_zh: 气候变化导致生活方式丧失——我们需要一种衡量方法
abstract: Climate losses extend beyond property and income. Policymakers need ways to assess what people value, experience and ultimately stand to lose.
abstract_zh: 气候损失不仅限于财产和收入。决策者需要方法来评估人们重视、体验以及最终可能失去的事物。
